items.title: XRP Ledger is one vote away from starting its next big payments upgrade
items.summary: Batch V1.1 would let users bundle up to eight linked transactions into one operation, with 27 of 35 trusted validators now backing the change.

items.title: Solana more than triples transaction size limit with mainnet upgrade
items.summary: Solana raised its transaction size limit to 4,096 bytes, giving developers more room for zero-knowledge proofs and transactions with multiple signatures.

items.title: Hong Kong crypto exchange CoinEx to cease operations after 9 years in business
items.summary: Founder and CEO Haipo Yang cited mounting security and compliance risks and said he rejected a sale in favor of a “clean ending.”

items.title: A bipartisan coalition of 17 state attorneys generals urge Senate to reject Clarity Act
items.summary: The state AGs said they were concerned the crypto legislation might restrict their ability to bring securities and commodities cases tied to online scams.

items.title: Why are AI’s biggest companies suddenly asking to slow down?
items.summary: AI’s biggest labs are suddenly calling for a slower pace of development. Is it because AI risks are catching up with the technology, or because the economics of the race are getting harder to justify?

items.title: King Charles to host AI chiefs amid industry call to slow development
items.summary: The gathering comes days after Dario Amodei and Sam Altman called for greater restraint at the AI frontier, warning that rapidly improving systems could pose increasingly difficult-to-control risks.

items.title: Anthropic chief urges slowdown in AI development to safer pace
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman agrees with safety concerns regarding AI development, says no initial share sale this year.

items.title: 1Password's AI patching benchmark is misleading

items.title: To ensure permanent economic innovation, we must pass the Clarity Act now
items.summary: Congress needs 60 Senators willing to put innovation first and provide critical relief to the digital asset industry, argues Rep. Shri Thanedar (D-Mich.)

items.title: Ether, solana, XRP likely to gain if Clarity Act progresses
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 15, 2026

items.title: Why banks should stop worrying and learn to love the Clarity Act
items.summary: They could be the biggest winners from regulatory clarity, argues Alex Tapscott, CEO of CMCC Global Capital Markets.

items.title: Velocity extends Series A to $48M at $200M valuation with backing from Visa, Circle, and Ripple
items.summary: The investment brings Velocity's Series A round to $48 million and values the London-based payments infrastructure firm at $200 million, CEO Eric Queathem said.

items.title: Bitcoin gives back Monday's gain as Clarity Act odds fade on Polymarket
items.summary: Bitcoin fell 1.7% since midnight UTC to $76,862, unwinding a late Monday rally as Polymarket odds on the Clarity Act becoming law this year halved overnight.

items.title: How a simple coding mistake let a hacker drain $7.8 million from a crypto wallet
items.summary: Security firms traced the $7.8 million loss to a helper contract the wallet owner had authorized, not to Safe itself.

items.title: Nigel Farage-backed Stack BTC eyes $16 million gold dealer deal to fund bitcoin buy
items.summary: The proposed acquisition would use cash flow from precious metals sales to build bitcoin holdings.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin slides to $77,000 as Senate votes on Clarity Act
items.summary: Senators take a procedural vote on the crypto market structure bill later Tuesday. Bitcoin has given back 3% since touching $79,530 overnight, with XRP and zcash the only majors gaining ground.

items.title: U.S. DOJ seeks $61 million in what it calls Iran's crypto-laundered black market oil sales
items.summary: Prosecutors have filed a civil forfeiture complaint against what they call Iran's illegal crypto proceeds that are used to fund its military.

items.title: Solana transactions just got more than 3 times bigger, narrowing the gap with Ethereum
items.summary: Transaction V1 raises Solana’s limit to 4,096 bytes from 1,232, giving developers more room for multi-step trades, company-wallet approvals and privacy proofs.

items.title: Democrats send counteroffer to Republicans over Clarity Act provisions
items.summary: Democratic Senators were said to be meeting late Monday to discuss the latest proposed draft text.

items.title: U.S. House panel shares crypto tax bill ahead of hearing later this week
items.summary: The House Ways and Means Committee published a crypto tax bill addressing de minimis transactions, staking and other issues for which the industry's clamored for policies.
